# dubwise

> A dub sound system in the browser: describe a riddim in your own words and it plays a synthesized one, live, offline, with no dependencies and no build step.

dubwise is a free, MIT-licensed web app at https://alb777.github.io/dubwise/. It writes dub reggae riddims from an
idea in English, Portuguese or Spanish, plays them with a drum machine, a sub bass, a skank, an organ bubble, chords
and a melodica line, and puts a tape echo, a spring reverb, a siren pad and a set of dub effects on the desk. Riddims
are stored as a plain text step notation, which is also a share link.

## Start

- [README](README.md): what the app does, how to run it and where it lives.
- [The app](https://alb777.github.io/dubwise/): the published version, a PWA that works offline.
- [Demo with sound](https://alb777.github.io/dubwise/docs/demo.mp4): a recorded session.

## Write riddims without the browser

- [Agent skill](skills/dubwise/SKILL.md): the `dubwise` skill, a composer and notation for an agent, offline.
- [CLI](skills/dubwise/cli.mjs): `compose`, `refine`, `check`, `url` and `spec` over the same composer.
- [Notation](skills/dubwise/scripts/notation.mjs): the riddim text format, one setting per line, 16 steps per bar.

```
node skills/dubwise/cli.mjs compose "a slow one drop for a rainy night"
node skills/dubwise/cli.mjs spec
```
